info.title: Crawlbase Universal API
info.description: Crawlbase provides crawling, scraping, screenshot, storage, account usage, and structured data extraction APIs for retrieving web data through Crawlbase infrastructure.

get.description: Retrieves a crawled page from Crawlbase.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Fully qualified URL to crawl. Crawlbase requires it to start with http or https.

schema.description: Fully qualified URL to crawl. Crawlbase requires it to start with http or https.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

body.description: Crawled response body when using JSON format.

original_status.description: HTTP status Crawlbase received from the target URL.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
